fields.label: Intro
fields.default: Small things we noticed while building invoicing software for freelancers. Unpolished on purpose, and updated when we change our minds.

itemFields.name: text
itemFields.label: Note
itemFields.default: Two or three sentences on something you noticed this week.

default.text: Moved the Send button from the top of the invoice to the bottom. People were sending before they had checked the total. Mis-sent invoices fell by a third in a week.
A customer told us she writes invoices on the train home, one-handed. We had never tested the editor with a thumb. We have now, and the line-item rows are a little taller.
Late-payment reminders work better when they sound like a person. Our plainest template, three sentences and no bold text, gets paid four days sooner than the formal one.
Wondering whether the dashboard needs a chart at all. Most people open Ledgerbird to answer one question: who still owes me money?
Started rounding tax per line instead of per invoice and broke nothing. It took four years to feel brave enough.
